items.question: Which countries do we sell to in Asia Pacific?
items.sql:
WITH apac_countries AS (
    SELECT c.code AS country_code,
           c.name AS country_name
    FROM countries c
    JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
    WHERE r.code = 'APAC'
)
SELECT country_code,
       country_name
FROM apac_countries
ORDER BY country_code;

items.question: What net revenue was attributed to each campaign for orders in 2026, by campaign name?

items.question: What was the average resolution time in hours of support tickets by region in 2026?
items.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    st.region_id,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) / 3600 AS resolution_hours
  FROM support_tickets st
  WHERE st.resolved_at IS NOT NULL
    AND st.resolved_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND st.resolved_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS region_code,
  r.name AS region_name,
  ROUND(AVG(f.resolution_hours)::numeric, 2) AS avg_resolution_hours
FROM filtered f
JOIN regions r ON r.id = f.region_id
GROUP BY r.code, r.name
ORDER BY r.code;

items.question: Show monthly net revenue for the last 12 months

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', order_date)::date AS month_start,
    net_revenue_usd
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-10-01'
    AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
)

  ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue

items.question: What was net revenue by region last calendar quarter vs the one before?
items.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT region_code, net_revenue_usd, ordered_at
    FROM order_revenue
    WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_revenue_q2,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_revenue_q3,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END),
    2) AS net_revenue_diff,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (
                SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
                - SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
            ) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END), 0)
        END,
    4) AS net_revenue_pct_change
FROM filtered
GROUP BY region_code
ORDER BY region_code;

items.question: How did the number of orders in each region change between calendar Q2 2026 and Q3 2026?
items.sql:
WITH q2 AS (
    SELECT region_code, region_name, COUNT(*) AS orders_q2
    FROM order_revenue
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY region_code, region_name
),
q3 AS (
    SELECT region_code, region_name, COUNT(*) AS orders_q3
    FROM order_revenue
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
    GROUP BY region_code, region_name
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(q2.region_code, q3.region_code) AS region_code,
    COALESCE(q2.region_name, q3.region_name) AS region_name,
    COALESCE(q2.orders_q2, 0) AS orders_q2,
    COALESCE(q3.orders_q3, 0) AS orders_q3,
    COALESCE(q3.orders_q3, 0) - COALESCE(q2.orders_q2, 0) AS orders_diff,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(q2.orders_q2, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(q3.orders_q3, 0) - COALESCE(q2.orders_q2, 0))::numeric / COALESCE(q2.orders_q2, 0), 4)
    END AS orders_pct_change
FROM q2
FULL OUTER JOIN q3 USING (region_code, region_name)
ORDER BY region_code;

items.question: What was the refund rate in each region in 2025 compared with 2026 so far?
items.sql:
WITH yr2025 AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    region_name,
    SUM(refund_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_revenue_usd), 0) AS refund_rate_2025
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY region_code, region_name
),
yr2026 AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    region_name,
    SUM(refund_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_revenue_usd), 0) AS refund_rate_2026
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY region_code, region_name
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(a.region_code, b.region_code) AS region_code,
  COALESCE(a.region_name, b.region_name) AS region_name,
  ROUND(a.refund_rate_2025, 4) AS refund_rate_2025,
  ROUND(b.refund_rate_2026, 4) AS refund_rate_2026,
  ROUND(b.refund_rate_2026 - a.refund_rate_2025, 4) AS refund_rate_diff,
  CASE
    WHEN a.refund_rate_2025 IS NULL OR a.refund_rate_2025 = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((b.refund_rate_2026 - a.refund_rate_2025) / a.refund_rate_2025, 4)
  END AS pct_change
FROM yr2025 a
FULL OUTER JOIN yr2026 b
  ON a.region_code = b.region_code AND a.region_name = b.region_name
ORDER BY region_code;

items.question: Which customers placed the most orders in 2025? Show the top 5, including anyone tied with the fifth.
items.sql:
WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        cp.customer_name,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM order_revenue o
    JOIN customer_profile cp ON o.customer_id = cp.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, cp.customer_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        order_count,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS dr
    FROM order_counts
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    order_count
FROM ranked
WHERE dr <= 5
ORDER BY order_count DESC, customer_id;

items.question: Of the customers whose first order was in January 2025, how many ordered again within 90 days of that first order?
items.sql:
WITH first AS (
  SELECT customer_id, first_order_at
  FROM customer_profile
  WHERE first_order_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND first_order_at < DATE '2025-02-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_id) AS customers_with_repeat_within_90d
FROM first f
JOIN order_revenue o
  ON o.customer_id = f.customer_id
 AND o.order_date > f.first_order_at
 AND o.order_date <= f.first_order_at + INTERVAL '90 days';

items.question: What share of customers who signed up in 2024 placed at least one order in 2026?
items.sql:
WITH signed_up_2024 AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM customer_profile
  WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
ordered_2026 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND ordered_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_2024_signups,
  COUNT(o.customer_id) AS ordered_in_2026,
  ROUND(COUNT(o.customer_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS share_ordered_2026
FROM signed_up_2024 su
LEFT JOIN ordered_2026 o ON su.customer_id = o.customer_id;

items.question: Among products with at least 100 units sold in 2025, which one had the highest refund rate?
items.sql:
WITH product_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    SUM(units) AS units_2025,
    SUM(gross_revenue_usd) AS gross_2025_raw,
    SUM(refund_usd) AS refund_2025_raw
  FROM order_line_revenue
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY product_id, product_name
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    units_2025,
    ROUND(gross_2025_raw, 2) AS gross_2025_usd,
    ROUND(refund_2025_raw, 2) AS refund_2025_usd,
    CASE WHEN gross_2025_raw = 0 THEN NULL ELSE refund_2025_raw / gross_2025_raw END AS refund_rate
  FROM product_2025
  WHERE units_2025 >= 100
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  product_name,
  units_2025,
  gross_2025_usd,
  refund_2025_usd,
  ROUND(refund_rate, 4) AS refund_rate
FROM filtered
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

items.question: How many customers have no known acquisition channel?
At which local hour of the day did APAC customers place the most orders in 2025?
items.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT o.ordered_at, r.timezone
    FROM orders o
    JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.id
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_test_account = false
      AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND r.code = 'APAC'
)
SELECT
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ordered_at AT TIME ZONE timezone)::int AS local_hour,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM filtered
GROUP BY local_hour
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
